title: Same Hand. Two Seats.

safeArea.note: Both YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels chrome must be clear. Nothing readable above y=250 or below y=1440.

semantics.rule: Red and cyan are never decorative. They only encode the two seats.

motion.hardRule: Audio-off comprehension. Every VO line has a matching type card at the same frame. There is no separate subtitle track; the kinetic type is the caption.

sfx.frameRules: one tick per seat, rising pitch, f345-f420

vo.character: warm, flat, conversational, no announcer energy

scenes.name: HOOK
scenes.visual: Black. 9-seat table ring fades to 20% opacity, reads as a diagram not a table. felt700 radial behind.

beats.animation: slamIn at f0. No logo, no greeting, no fade from black.

beats.prevTextReaction: SAME HAND. rises to y=700 and shrinks to claim size (96px)
beats.animation: slamIn. seat1 pulses 'early'; seat6 pulses 'late' with 8-frame offset.
slamIn. Vertical hairline splits frame; left half +8% early tint, right half +8% late tint. Ring to 45% opacity.

scenes.name: THE HAND
scenes.visual: Hook text snapOut in one move. Table ring rotates 12 degrees so seat 1 sits top-left (9-handed orientation) and holds for the rest of the video.

beats.vo: Ace-jack suited. Everyone gets this hand.
beats.animation: Two dealCard presets 10 frames apart, spring overshoot settles.

beats.vo: Where you sit decides what it's worth.
beats.animation: Card pair duplicates (40% -> 100% crossfade); left copy slides left + tints 'early', right copy slides right + tints 'late'. 14-frame spring slide.
Card copies shrink to 120x170 and park at y=1290 as persistent HUD. A 3px 'chip' arc draws clockwise around the ring over 30 frames (stroke dashoffset). Motif returns in S3 and reverses in S4.

scenes.name: EARLY POSITION - THE PROBLEM
scenes.visual: Everything dims to 30%. Seat 1 lights 'early'. This is the bad-line act.

beats.vo: From under the gun, you're first to act-
beats.animation: Seat 1 slam-pulses; 2px 'early' ring stays lit.

Chevron arrows sweep clockwise from seat 1, 9 frames total, one seat per tick, each lighting that seat dot in 'early' at 25%. Rising-pitch tick per seat. HOLD this beat - it is the most literal read of the seat diagram.

beats.vo: You have no idea what's coming.
beats.animation: A '?' glyph pops on each of the 8 seats sequentially (6 frames each, overlapping); all collapse to 40% opacity together at f490.

beats.vo: So you guess. With the worst information at the table.
beats.animation: Desaturate everything to 'mute' in 10 frames; stamp slamIn; 3-frame shake (the ONLY shake in the video).

scenes.name: LATE POSITION - THE FIX
scenes.visual: Hard cut on the beat (no crossfade). Full colour returns, ring brightens, seat 6 (button) lights 'late'. The arc motif now animates COUNTER-clockwise: information flowing in, not decisions flowing out.

beats.vo: On the button, you act last.
beats.animation: Hard cut. Gold button disc (90px) drops onto seat 6 and lands on the deal spring.

beats.vo: Every player has already decided before you do.
beats.animation: 8 small 'late' dots travel seat->button along the arc, spread across 52 frames; each landing nudges the button ring +4%.

beats.rowGeometry: 3 rows, 95px pitch, label left / value right, 1px felt700 divider. Last row baseline 1200 - inside the y<=1440 safe band with 240px to spare.
beats.vo: You know who folded, who limped, who raised - and how much.
beats.animation: Rows riseIn 12 frames apart with 1px felt700 dividers. Values countUp. Chips stack behind the readout in 3 denominations.
First line riseIn ivory. Second slams over it in 'late' with a 2px 'late' underline drawn left-to-right in 6 frames.

scenes.name: THE EDGE - PAYOFF
scenes.visual: Frame splits down the middle - the S1.3 hairline returns as a real divider. Left = red seat, right = cyan seat. SAME cards, both sides. This is the screenshot frame.

beats.vo: Same cards. Same opponents. Same board.
beats.animation: splitWipe 6 frames. Both mini-card pairs land on the SAME frame - the identicalness is the argument.

beats.vo: The only thing that changed is what you knew.
beats.animation: 2-frame ivory flash at 12% (the ONLY flash), then slamIn. Divider lines retract upward in 8 frames.

beats.vo: Position doesn't change your cards. It changes how much you know when you act.
beats.animation: wordStagger at 3 frames per word - the ONLY staggered build. Then 20 frames of complete stillness (f1165-1185): nothing moves, let it land.

scenes.name: RULE CARD + LOOP
scenes.visual: Rule panel: rounded 24px, felt700 at 90%, 1px chip hairline, 940x480px, centred y=880.

beats.vo: Tight up front. Wide on the button.
beats.preRoll: Frames 1155-1185 are dead air with the music dropped out. The silence is the punctuation - do not fill it.
beats.animation: Panel scales 0.96 -> 1.00 in 10 frames, then lines slamIn sequentially. Chime.

beats.vo: That's it. That's the whole edge.
beats.animation: micro fades up over 10 frames.
Panel and type snapOut. Ring returns dimmed to 20%, seats unlit, background felt900. Frame 1349 must be visually identical to frame 0 for a seamless loop.

renderedChecks: no readable element above y=250 or below y=1440
every VO line has matching on-screen type at the same frame
red only on early/blind, cyan only on late/informed
exactly 1 shake, 1 white flash, 1 word stagger
muted playback teaches the full lesson
>= 1s silence before the rule card survives the mix

titles: Same hand. Two seats. Two different results.
Why position beats good cards at $1/$2

packaging.coverRationale: Split hook mid-fade: strongest red/cyan contrast at 12px grid size; must read as 'two things, opposite colours' as a thumbnail.
